description: Exploit and test the FixRes mechanism: the closing full-res phase only needs to re-fit BN stats and the head, so it can be shorter. On the current incumbent (E030, or the low-res-epoch variant if that run is kept), move one 32 px epoch to 28 px: 2x20+3x24+3x28+3x32 (11 epochs, same LR schedule over total steps, same 4 graphs). Change nothing else. Run salt 0 and salt 1 and compare against the pooled estimate, since the expected effect is near the noise.
